IT Audit & Technology Risk Controls (Code Review) | Associate Con / Con / AM

Location: Bengaluru (Preferred)
Experience: 3-7 Years
Employment Type: Full-time


About the Role

We are looking for IT Audit & Technology Risk professionals with strong experience in IT General Controls (ITGC), IT Application Controls (ITAC), and technology risk assessments. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience evaluating IT controls across enterprise applications and IT infrastructure, along with the ability to understand and review application code to validate automated controls and business logic.

This role focuses on strengthening clients technology risk, governance, compliance, and internal control environments through IT audits, control assessments, and code reviews.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform IT General Controls (ITGC) assessments covering:
    • User Access Management
    • Change Management
    • Computer Operations
    • Backup & Recovery
    • Incident & Problem Management
    • Batch Job Scheduling & Monitoring
    • Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery
  • Execute IT Application Controls (ITAC) testing, including:
    • Input Controls
    • Processing Controls
    • Output Controls
    • Interface Controls
    • Data Validation Controls
    • Input Process Output (IPO/IPE) Controls
    • Data Completeness & Accuracy Controls
  • Perform walkthroughs with business and technology stakeholders to understand business processes, system architecture, and control environments.
  • Conduct design and operating effectiveness testing of automated and manual controls.
  • Perform source code reviews to validate application controls, business rules, data processing logic, exception handling, and automated control implementation.
  • Review system configurations and application settings supporting financial and operational processes.
  • Prepare Risk & Control Matrices (RCMs), process flow diagrams, audit workpapers, testing documentation, and audit observations.
  • Identify control gaps, technology risks, and process weaknesses, and provide practical remediation recommendations.
  • Support IT Internal Audits, SOX compliance engagements, Internal Financial Controls (IFC), Technology Risk Assessments, and Risk Advisory engagements.
  • Coordinate with client stakeholders throughout planning, walkthroughs, testing, reporting, and closure activities.

Mandatory Skills

Candidates must have hands-on experience in most of the following areas:

IT Audit & Controls

  • IT General Controls (ITGC / GITC)
  • IT Application Controls (ITAC)
  • IT Internal Audit
  • Technology Risk Assessment
  • Risk & Control Matrix (RCM)
  • Control Design & Operating Effectiveness Testing
  • Business Process Walkthroughs
  • Audit Documentation

ITGC Areas

  • User Access Management
  • Change Management
  • Incident Management
  • Computer Operations
  • Backup Management
  • Batch Job Monitoring
  • Business Continuity
  • Disaster Recovery

ITAC Areas

  • Input Controls
  • Processing Controls
  • Output Controls
  • Interface Controls
  • Data Integrity Controls
  • Data Completeness & Accuracy
  • Input Process Output (IPO/IPE) Controls
  • Automated Controls Testing

Code Review & Technical Knowledge

Candidates should possess the ability to understand application code and validate business logic during audits.

Exposure to one or more of the following technologies is required:

  • Java
  • SQL
  • JavaScript
  • C
  • C++

Development experience is not mandatory; however, candidates should be comfortable interpreting source code during audit engagements.

Preferred Skills

  • SOX 404 Controls Testing
  • Internal Financial Controls (IFC)
  • Information Security Assessments
  • ERP Controls Review
  • SDLC Controls
  • Data Migration Controls
  • Cloud Technology Audits
  • Interface Testing
  • Financial Services Technology Audits

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in ITGC and ITAC assessments, be capable of reviewing application code to validate automated controls, understand enterprise technology environments, possess solid knowledge of SOX and technology risk frameworks, and demonstrate excellent analytical, stakeholder management, communication, and audit documentation skills.

Job Title:ServiceNow Business Analyst - Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM)

Corporate Title: Analyst

Experience-5-8 years

Location- Bangalore

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced ServiceNow Business Analyst with expertise in Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) to gather business requirements, design ServiceNow TPRM solutions, and support implementation across the third-party lifecycle. The ideal candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, risk teams, security, procurement, and ServiceNow technical teams to deliver scalable governance, risk, and compliance solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Gather, analyze, and document business requirements for ServiceNow TPRM implementations.
  • Conduct workshops with Procurement, Vendor Management, Information Security, Legal, Compliance, Privacy, and Risk teams.
  • Translate business requirements into functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flows.
  • Configure and support ServiceNow TPRM modules in collaboration with developers.
  • Define and optimize third-party onboarding, assessment, due diligence, issue management, remediation, and offboarding processes.
  • Configure questionnaires, assessment templates, risk scoring models, and workflow automation.
  • Design integrations with external security assessment tools (e.g., SecurityScorecard, BitSight, OneTrust, Archer, etc.) where applicable.
  • Support Agile ceremonies including backlog grooming, sprint planning, demos, and UAT.
  • Prepare functional design documents, BRDs, FRDs, test cases, and training materials.
  • Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and production deployments.
  • Provide post-go-live support and continuous process improvement recommendations.
  • Ensure compliance with enterprise governance and regulatory requirements.

Required Skills

ServiceNow

  • ServiceNow TPRM
  • Integrated Risk Management (IRM)
  • Vendor Risk Management (VRM)
  • Risk Assessment Framework
  • Assessment Designer
  • Flow Designer
  • IntegrationHub
  • Service Catalog
  • Workflow/Process Automation
  • Reporting and Dashboards

Business Analysis

  • Requirement Gathering
  • Process Mapping (BPMN/Visio)
  • Gap Analysis
  • User Stories
  • BRD/FRD
  • Functional Specifications
  • UAT Management
  • Stakeholder Management

Risk & Compliance

  • Third-Party Risk Management Lifecycle
  • Vendor Onboarding
  • Due Diligence
  • Risk Assessments
  • Remediation Tracking
  • Exception Management
  • Continuous Monitoring
  • Regulatory Compliance

Experience

  • 5-8+ years as a Business Analyst.
  • 3+ years working on ServiceNow IRM/TPRM implementations.
  • Experience implementing end-to-end TPRM lifecycle.
  • Experience working with Agile/Scrum methodologies.
  • Knowledge of ServiceNow data model and integrations.
  • Experience in banking, healthcare, manufacturing, or regulated industries is preferred.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or related field.
  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) - Preferred.
  • ServiceNow IRM/TPRM Implementation certification - Preferred.
  • CBAP, CCBA, or PMI-PBA certification is an advantage.

Key Competencies

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management.
  • Ability to facilitate workshops and requirement sessions.
  • Strong documentation skills.
  • Risk-based thinking.
  • Attention to detail.
  • Ability to work with cross-functional global teams.

ERM is the world s largest specialist sustainability consultancy, with over 50 years of experience helping organizations navigate complex environmental, social, and governance challenges. We bring together a global community of experts to deliver meaningful impact for our clients and the planet.

Our Consulting Delivery Hub (CDH) in India is a critical part of ERM s global consulting model enabling scalable, high-quality delivery across regions and service lines. CDH teams work in close partnership with regional consultants to support global client projects, providing specialist expertise, driving consistency, and enhancing delivery efficiency across our most important programmes.

As part of the Consulting Delivery Hub, you will collaborate with colleagues worldwide, contribute to complex sustainability projects, and play a key role in shaping the future of global consulting delivery.

Why this role matters

As a Consulting Senior Associate, Audit you will support ERM s global consulting delivery by supporting audit engagements under direction, completing assigned audit tasks, maintaining evidence records and applying ERM methodologies consistently. You will work within EHS Audit in the Consulting Delivery Hub, partnering with regional consultants, audit team leads, client process owners and internal delivery teams to deliver accurate evidence, working papers and audit documentation. This role is critical to consistent delivery quality, reliable audit evidence and efficient support to global client programmes.


What your impact is

  • Support delivery of ERM audit engagements that help clients shape a sustainable future.

  • Assist with audit planning, logistics, checklists, protocols and working papers accurately and on time.

  • Gather and record evidence, support sampling and testing, perform basic checks and flag exceptions early.

  • Help draft findings and maintain organized evidence records that clearly support conclusions.

  • Apply ERM and client health, safety, ethics and governance requirements, including independence expectations.

  • Build core audit capability through structured learning, fieldwork exposure and knowledge sharing.

What will you bring

  • Entry-level experience or strong interest in audit, environmental compliance, EHS, sustainability, engineering or related consulting domain.

  • Basic understanding of internal controls, audit concepts, evidence gathering and documentation discipline.

  • Strong Excel, documentation, attention to detail and willingness to learn structured audit methods.

  • Good communication skills and ability to work with global teams, regional consultants and client stakeholders.

  • Ability to complete assigned tasks to deadlines and escalate issues clearly when support is needed.

  • Willingness to travel for fieldwork where project requirements apply.

  • Bachelors degree in environmental, sustainability, health & safety science, engineering or a related discipline; early-career EHS experience in consulting or industry.

  • Awareness of ISO and relevant EHS management -system standards.

  • 1+ years of experience in Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS), environmental compliance, environmental auditing or related consulting services.

Preferred skills & competencies

  • Working towards internal-auditor, EHS auditor or management-system auditor training.

  • Exposure to EHS regulatory compliance audits or management-system assessments.

  • Familiarity with audit checklists, protocols, working-paper systems, data tracking or basic automation tools.

  • Interest in international and National standards and initiatives.

Key responsibilities

  • Support the Audit Team Lead in preparing audit documentation and planning logistics.

  • Complete assigned checklists, protocols and working papers accurately and within agreed timelines.

  • Gather, record and organize audit evidence against defined audit criteria.

  • Support sampling and testing activities, perform basic checks and flag exceptions or gaps.

  • Assist with drafting findings, observations and evidence summaries for team review.

  • Maintain audit logs, findings trackers and evidence record in a clear and auditable manner.

  • Support opening and closing meeting logistics, including notetaking where requested.

  • Follow ERM and client health, safety, ethics, confidentiality and governance requirements.

  • Deliver high standards of work to meet and exceed internal client expectations.

  • Build meaningful internal and external client relationships.

  • Maintain audit logs, findings trackers and working-paper records within audit systems.

  • Support EHS regulatory compliance audits and management-system assessments under direction, within ERMs Safe & Sustainable Operations practice; exposure to high-hazard sectors (mining, oil & gas, petrochemicals, pulp & paper, power generation).

  • Exposure to supporting environmental compliance audits or management system audits for clients in North America (NA) and/or EMEA (Europe, Middle East & Africa) is preferred.

  • Professional certifications such as ISO 14001:2015 Internal Auditor, ISO 45001:2018 Internal Auditor, ISO 9001:2015 Internal Auditor, or equivalent audit-related certifications are desirable.

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Provide day to day Application Management support for SAP Applications across IT Service Management including service requests, incident management, enhancement requests, change management and problem management as Level 2 or 3 Application Management Specialist
  • Lead and mentor the entire FI team fostering culture of collaboration, innovation and continuous improvement
  • Lead and Coordinate the Resolution of Complex Technical issues and System Outages including root cause analysis and corrective action.
  • Set up the SAP RAR module to automate revenue recognition, contract management, and performance obligation (POB) assignments
  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to gather requirements, assess business needs and provide advice on SAP FICO solutions and designs.
  • Set up the SAP RAR module to automate revenue recognition, contract management, and performance obligation (POB) assignments
  • Develop and maintain documentation including configuration, user guides and test scripts.
  • Mentor and train junior SAP FICO Team Members, sharing best practices and providing guidance on issues and troubleshooting techniques.
  • Keep abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies and SAP best practices to drive operational efficiency through automation and innovation
  • Participate in on-call rotation and provide off hours support as needed to ensure the availability and reliability of critical SAP systems.
  • Available to work on shift hours depending on the requirement of the client (AUSTRALIA, ASIA, Europe and AMERICAS hours)
  • Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
  • Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

Skills and attributes for success

  • Bachelors degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.) or comparable job experiences.
  • 4+ Years of experience required in one or more areas within SAP FICO and RAR preferably with Global client
  • Specialization in configuring and implementing SAP RAR (1.2/1.3 or S/4HANA) to comply with IFRS 15/ASC 606 standards
  • Managed performance obligations (POBs), contract management, and integration with SD/FI/CO modules
  • Deep understanding of ITIL and ITSM processes and methodology and how it interacts with the application lifecycle management principles
  • Proven track record of successfully driving solutions in a complex, multi-platform environment
  • Extensive in client management working with various regions in a global setting
  • Depth of experience in setting up, growing, transforming, and delivering application management teams
  • Strong leadership and team building skills with the ability to inspire and motivate teams to achieve excellence
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to effectively engage and influence stakeholders at all levels in the organization
  • Strong client management, analytical and problem-solving skills with ability to think strategically and make data driven decisions
  • Responsible for providing support SAP FICO module incidents, ensuring minimal disruption to operations.
  • Support incident solving by analyzing incidents raised by users and provides solutions.
  • Working closely with customers and teams to ensure issues and requests are followed-up and addressed timely.
  • Handle change requests with a clear understanding of new business requirements.
  • Understand business needs and deliver solutions to make processes more efficient and simpler whenever possible.
  • Cross-functional communication skills; experience in offshore/onsite model.
  • Defect resolution and defect analysis related to FICO.
  • Ability to work with minimal guidance or supervision in a time critical environment.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and leadership skills with the ability to work effectively in a global, cross functional team environment.

Ideally, you’ll also

  • Integration knowledge RAR with SAP SD, FICO, and SAP BRIM, utilizing BRF+ (Business Rule Framework) for complex rules.
  • Expertise is reporting options in RAR and worked on Functional Specification for custom RICEF objects
  • Experience as SME with FICO module (G/L, Account receivable, Accounts Payable, Banking Accounting, Asset Accounting, COPA, Profit Center Accounting, Product Costing, Profitability Analysis, Project System, Results Analysis, Unsettled Costs, Month End & Year end close, Overhead assessment and settlement)
  • Strong knowledge of FI integration points with other SAP modules like MM, SD, HR, PP and PM.
  • SAP Certification in SAP FICO

Job DescriptionJob Description

The MDG Technical Developer will be responsible for Designing & developing new features in our MDG application while collaborating with the functional team, the application architecture team & consulting partners.  

The applicant is encouraged to have a strong background in core MDG Application and should have worked on Implementation projects involving SAP MDG Solution for either of the following: Material, Customer, Vendor, Financial masters.

What You Will Do

  • Involved in building scalable & reliable solutions
  • Collaborate with the functional leads and work on translating requirements to efficient code
  • Accountable for code quality & technical documentation
  • Designing & developing prototypes of the solution when required
  • Assisting in solution support 
  • Ensure adherence to Development, Compliance & Security standards
  • Build an environment for developing innovative solutions with a strong emphasis on automating work where possible
  • Be able to communicate (Speak, Read and Write) in English very well.

Qualifications You Must Have 

  • Bachelors degree, preferably in the field of Information Technology or Computer Science
  • Overall 5+ years of technical experience with minimum 4 years of relevant experience coding in S4 Hana and SAP MDG
  • A thorough hands-on knowledge in OO ABAP, BRF+, MDG Workflows, CAP/RAP/API’s, handling extensions (Classic / In-App / Side by Side), FIORI apps, BTP, FIORI elements, OData services, CDS views in MDG is required.
  • 2 to 5 years of detailed experience in the below
    • ABAP CDS views with UI5 annotations, OData, REST/JSON, XML (including debugging)
    • Experience in CDS Frameworks using ABAP PROGRAMMING MODEL FOR SAP FIORI (CAP-Cloud Application & RAP)
    • MDG Data Replication Framework and Integration with ERP using BAPI, RFC, IDOC, WSDL, PI Proxies and OData REST APIs
    • Good knowledge of ABAP 7.x coding standards and using ABAP Development Tools.
    • Hands-on development experience of RICEF objects in ABAP on HANA
    • Knowledge of BADIs, User Exits, Customer Exits and Enhancement Spots
    • Hands on experience of tools like Business Rules Framework (BRF+), Business Application Studio (BAS), SAP HANA Studio (Eclipse) & GIT.
    • Worked on any SAP MDG custom objects to build solution on client requirements.
  • Experience in supporting UAT phase and go-live period of MDG Implementation project.
  • Establish clear expectations regarding status reporting, team communication and deliverable management.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively.
  • Strong conceptual, analytical, problem-solving, troubleshooting and resolution skills.

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience across various tools such as Solution Manager, JIRA & knowledge of CI/CD concepts
  • Knowledge of AIF, Flexible Workflows
  • Relevant SAP Certifications

Job Title:ServiceNow Business Analyst - Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM)

Corporate Title: Analyst

Experience-5-8 years

Location- Bangalore

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced ServiceNow Business Analyst with expertise in Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) to gather business requirements, design ServiceNow TPRM solutions, and support implementation across the third-party lifecycle. The ideal candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, risk teams, security, procurement, and ServiceNow technical teams to deliver scalable governance, risk, and compliance solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Gather, analyze, and document business requirements for ServiceNow TPRM implementations.
  • Conduct workshops with Procurement, Vendor Management, Information Security, Legal, Compliance, Privacy, and Risk teams.
  • Translate business requirements into functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flows.
  • Configure and support ServiceNow TPRM modules in collaboration with developers.
  • Define and optimize third-party onboarding, assessment, due diligence, issue management, remediation, and offboarding processes.
  • Configure questionnaires, assessment templates, risk scoring models, and workflow automation.
  • Design integrations with external security assessment tools (e.g., SecurityScorecard, BitSight, OneTrust, Archer, etc.) where applicable.
  • Support Agile ceremonies including backlog grooming, sprint planning, demos, and UAT.
  • Prepare functional design documents, BRDs, FRDs, test cases, and training materials.
  • Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and production deployments.
  • Provide post-go-live support and continuous process improvement recommendations.
  • Ensure compliance with enterprise governance and regulatory requirements.

Required Skills

ServiceNow

  • ServiceNow TPRM
  • Integrated Risk Management (IRM)
  • Vendor Risk Management (VRM)
  • Risk Assessment Framework
  • Assessment Designer
  • Flow Designer
  • IntegrationHub
  • Service Catalog
  • Workflow/Process Automation
  • Reporting and Dashboards

Business Analysis

  • Requirement Gathering
  • Process Mapping (BPMN/Visio)
  • Gap Analysis
  • User Stories
  • BRD/FRD
  • Functional Specifications
  • UAT Management
  • Stakeholder Management

Risk & Compliance

  • Third-Party Risk Management Lifecycle
  • Vendor Onboarding
  • Due Diligence
  • Risk Assessments
  • Remediation Tracking
  • Exception Management
  • Continuous Monitoring
  • Regulatory Compliance

Experience

  • 5-8+ years as a Business Analyst.
  • 3+ years working on ServiceNow IRM/TPRM implementations.
  • Experience implementing end-to-end TPRM lifecycle.
  • Experience working with Agile/Scrum methodologies.
  • Knowledge of ServiceNow data model and integrations.
  • Experience in banking, healthcare, manufacturing, or regulated industries is preferred.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or related field.
  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) - Preferred.
  • ServiceNow IRM/TPRM Implementation certification - Preferred.
  • CBAP, CCBA, or PMI-PBA certification is an advantage.

Key Competencies

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management.
  • Ability to facilitate workshops and requirement sessions.
  • Strong documentation skills.
  • Risk-based thinking.
  • Attention to detail.
  • Ability to work with cross-functional global teams.

Role Description : Roles & Responsibilities.

In this vital role you will be responsible for designing, configuring, and integrating SAP QM processes within S/4HANA across all the Amgen manufacturing and distribution sites. This role focuses on leveraging SAP technologies to streamline and enhance QM processes, ensuring alignment with business needs and industry best practices. As an Sr Associate SAP Architect , you will work closely with operations IT and business stakeholders in Manufacturing, Supply Chain and Procurement to ensure quality processes are seamlessly integrated and compliant with regulatory standards. This position requires deep expertise in SAP S/4 HANA QM & PP-PI modules with cross-functional collaboration with MM, SD, EWM and EAM modules to optimize quality inspection, notification and audit processes.

  • Design, configuration, and implementation of SAP S/4HANA Quality Management processes.
  • Design, configuration, and implementation of SAP S/4HANA PP-PI module aligned with life sciences manufacturing best practices
  • Translate business requirements into SAP QM functional specifications aligned with life sciences regulatory needs (GxP, GMP, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, ISO 9001).
  • Configure inspection planning, results recording, usage decisions, and quality notifications
  • Support integration with related modules including MM (Procurement), PP (Production), PM (Maintenance), and EWM (Warehouse Management).
  • Conduct architectural reviews and assessments to identify potential risks and recommend mitigation strategies
  • Creation and maintenance of critical documentation such as technical assessments, configuration specs, functional designs, test cases, and user manuals. Ensure compliance with pharmaceutical industry standards and regulations.
  • Participate in sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives to deliver and sustain Amgen''s S/4HANA ecosystem utilizing the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe)
  • Develop innovative solutions that drive speed to value via AI/ML and leading practices

Functional Skills : Must-have-skills

  • Strong Hands-on in end-to-end QM processes: inspection planning, notifications, batch management, and audit handling. Integration experience with SAP EWM, LIMS, MES and other non-SAP systems
  • Strong Hands-on in production & planning, master data, Material masters, BOM, Resource, Recipe, production version, Demand management, MRP, process orders etc.
  • Experience in regulated environments (Life Sciences, Biotech, or pharmaceutical industry)
  • Deep understanding of GxP, GMP, and FDA 21 CFR Part 11 requirements.
  • Experience working in multi-site or global SAP S/4 rollouts.
  • Ability to design and implement solutions based on business requirements, including debugging and root cause analysis.
  • Experience in creating detailed documentation, including functional specifications, test cases, and compliance reports.

Nice-to-have-skills:

  • Knowledge of Batch release hub.
  • Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA MM and SD processes
  • Integration experience with SAP EWM, LIMS, MES and other non-SAP systems
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies for software delivery and process improvement.

Professional Certifications:

  • SAP Certified Application Associate in SAP S/4HANA QM & PP-PI modules.
  • Agile Certified Practitioner (preferred)

Soft Skills:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Detail-oriented with a focus on accuracy and compliance.

Basic Qualifications & Experience:

  • Masters degree with 1 to 3 years of SAP implementation experience in SAP S/4HANA Quality Management & Production & Planning modules OR
  • Bachelors degree with 3 to 5 years of SAP implementation experience in SAP S/4HANA Quality Management & Production & Planning modules OR
  • Diploma with 7 to 9 years of IT or years of SAP implementation experience in SAP S/4HANA Quality Management & Production & Planning modules.

Shift Information:

This position requires you to work a later shift and may be assigned a second shift schedule. Candidates must be willing and able to work during evening shift, as required based on business requirements.

Job Purpose
The Consulting IAM Application Engineer leads the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) systems, ensuring scalability, compliance, and operational excellence. This role goes beyond application onboarding to architect and enhance IGA capabilities across the enterprise, integrating with broader IT and security ecosystems. Key responsibilities include engineering and maintaining IGA workflows, tailoring tools to organizational needs, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to resolve issues and drive innovation. The role also involves mentoring team members, applying software design patterns, and ensuring alignment with key performance indicators. The engineer supports audits, evaluates new technologies, and participates in a 24x7x365 on-call rotation to ensure uninterrupted support for critical systems.
The Consulting IAM System Engineer is expected to fortify our organization and spearhead the crafting, execution, and upkeep of our identity governance and administration (IGA) systems. As a Consulting IAM Application Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in masterminding, broadening, and refining our IGA capabilities beyond application onboarding. You will unite with cross-functional teams, including IT administrators, security analysts, and business stakeholders, to guarantee the effective utilization and continuous enhancement of our IGA systems. You will act as a team lead empowering other team members, and encourage growth among team members. You will help to apply software design patterns to achieve a consistent and standards approach to implementation of new features and expanding the connection with other enterprise systems with key performance indicators in focus.
Major Responsibilities and Accountabilities
  • Engineer and sustain our identity governance and administration (IGA) systems, including architecture, workflows, and integration with various systems.
  • Strategize with stakeholders to capture requirements and translate them into technical specifications and design documents for IGA system advancements.
  • Tailor and refine IGA tools and technologies to meet the organization's specific needs, ensuring optimal system performance.
  • Craft and preserve IGA operational procedures, guidelines, and documentation for user onboarding, access provisioning, and access recertification.
  • Synergize with cross-functional teams to diagnose and remedy any issues related to the IGA systems, securing timely resolution and minimal disruption.
  • Monitor and evaluate IGA system performance and security logs, proactively safeguarding against any anomalies or security incidents.
  • Keep abreast of emerging IGA trends, technologies, and best practices, proposing recommendations for process improvements and system enhancements.
  • Provide technical expertise and support to IT teams and end-users, resolving IGA-related issues.
  • Cultivate a culture of security awareness and continuous improvement, championing IGA best practices and knowledge sharing within the organization.
  • Collaborate with internal and external auditors to support IGA-related audits and assessments, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies.
  • Evaluate and select IGA tools and technologies, recommending based on organizational needs, scalability, and ease of use.
  • As we support hospitals that care for patients 24x7x365, commit to 24x7x365 on-call support rotation with 10-minute response times.

Job Title: SAP Commissions Consultant/SAP APM Specialist
Role Overview
We are seeking a skilled SAP Commissions Consultant/SAP APM Specialist to design, implement, and support performance management solutions for agent-based organizations. The candidate will be responsible for configuring SAP APM modules, managing incentive compensation processes, and improving business visibility into agent productivity and performance.
Key Responsibilities
1. Implementation & Configuration

  • Configure and implement SAP Agent Performance Management (APM) / SAP Commissions solutions.
  • Design compensation plans, incentive structures, and performance metrics.
  • Customize workflows, rules, and calculations based on business requirements.

2. Business Requirement Analysis

  • Work with stakeholders (Sales, HR, Finance) to gather business requirements.
  • Translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.
  • Recommend best practices for incentive compensation design.

3. Support & Maintenance

  • Provide ongoing support for SAP APM applications.
  • Troubleshoot system issues and optimize performance.
  • Manage upgrades, patches, and enhancements.
  • Ensure system compliance with organizational policies.

Required Skills & Qualifications
Technical Skills

  • Strong experience in SAP Agent Performance Management (APM) / SAP Commissions.
  • Knowledge of incentive compensation management (ICM) processes.
  • Experience with SQL, data modeling, and reporting tools.
  • Experience in Groovy Script

Functional Skills

  • Knowledge of sales compensation plans and commission structures.
  • Understanding of finance, payroll, and HR processes.
  • Experience in requirement gathering and business process mapping.

Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management.
  • Ability to work in cross-functional teams.


Experience Requirements

  • 38 years of experience in SAP APM / SAP Commissions or similar tools.
  • Experience in at least one full-cycle implementation project preferred.
  • Insurance Industry is advantageous.

Education

  • B.Tech
  • SAP certification in APM/Commissions is preferred.

About the Role

We are looking for IT Audit & Technology Risk professionals with strong experience in IT General Controls (ITGC), IT Application Controls (ITAC), and technology risk assessments. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience evaluating IT controls across enterprise applications and IT infrastructure, along with the ability to understand and review application code to validate automated controls and business logic.

This role focuses on strengthening clients’ technology risk, governance, compliance, and internal control environments through IT audits, control assessments, and code reviews.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform IT General Controls (ITGC) assessments covering:
    • User Access Management
    • Change Management
    • Computer Operations
    • Backup & Recovery
    • Incident & Problem Management
    • Batch Job Scheduling & Monitoring
    • Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery
  • Execute IT Application Controls (ITAC) testing, including:
    • Input Controls
    • Processing Controls
    • Output Controls
    • Interface Controls
    • Data Validation Controls
    • Input Process Output (IPO/IPE) Controls
    • Data Completeness & Accuracy Controls
  • Perform walkthroughs with business and technology stakeholders to understand business processes, system architecture, and control environments.
  • Conduct design and operating effectiveness testing of automated and manual controls.
  • Perform source code reviews to validate application controls, business rules, data processing logic, exception handling, and automated control implementation.
  • Review system configurations and application settings supporting financial and operational processes.
  • Prepare Risk & Control Matrices (RCMs), process flow diagrams, audit workpapers, testing documentation, and audit observations.
  • Identify control gaps, technology risks, and process weaknesses, and provide practical remediation recommendations.
  • Support IT Internal Audits, SOX compliance engagements, Internal Financial Controls (IFC), Technology Risk Assessments, and Risk Advisory engagements.
  • Coordinate with client stakeholders throughout planning, walkthroughs, testing, reporting, and closure activities.

Mandatory Skills

Candidates must have hands-on experience in most of the following areas:

IT Audit & Controls

  • IT General Controls (ITGC / GITC)
  • IT Application Controls (ITAC)
  • IT Internal Audit
  • Technology Risk Assessment
  • Risk & Control Matrix (RCM)
  • Control Design & Operating Effectiveness Testing
  • Business Process Walkthroughs
  • Audit Documentation

ITGC Areas

  • User Access Management
  • Change Management
  • Incident Management
  • Computer Operations
  • Backup Management
  • Batch Job Monitoring
  • Business Continuity
  • Disaster Recovery

ITAC Areas

  • Input Controls
  • Processing Controls
  • Output Controls
  • Interface Controls
  • Data Integrity Controls
  • Data Completeness & Accuracy
  • Input Process Output (IPO/IPE) Controls
  • Automated Controls Testing

Code Review & Technical Knowledge

Candidates should possess the ability to understand application code and validate business logic during audits.

Exposure to one or more of the following technologies is required:

  • Java
  • SQL
  • JavaScript
  • C
  • C++

Development experience is not mandatory; however, candidates should be comfortable interpreting source code during audit engagements.

Should work in rotation shifts from 6PM to 3AM IST or 1AM to 9AM IST.


About the Role:

Loginsoft's AI-powered scanner analyzes thousands of open source packages and extensions daily, flagging potential malware, supply chain attacks, and suspicious behavior across npm, PyPI, Chrome extensions, VS Code extensions, and more.

As a Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) Threat Analyst, you are the critical human judgment layer in this pipeline. Your role is to review AI-flagged threats in real time, make fast and accurate triage decisions, escalate high-severity findings, and ensure the feed maintains the quality standard that Loginsoft's customers depend on.

This is a 12/7 operation. You will work rotating shifts between 6PM to 9AM IST to provide continuous coverage of the threat feed. Shift schedules are designed for global coverage across time zones.


What youll do:Threat Triage & Review

  • Review AI-flagged packages and extensions in real time confirm, dismiss, or escalate each finding with documented reasoning.
  • Apply consistent triage standards to classify threats: malware, typosquatting, dependency confusion, data exfiltration, obfuscated code, and other supply chain attack patterns.
  • Perform quick static analysis on flagged code snippets to validate or override AI assessments.
  • Maintain a high-volume review throughput without sacrificing accuracy — quality is the benchmark

Escalation & Communication

  • Escalate critical or novel threats immediately to the senior Threat Research team using defined severity protocols.
  • Write clear, concise triage notes for each reviewed item — decisions must be auditable and informative for downstream teams.
  • Flag patterns or campaigns that emerge across multiple packages for deeper investigation.

Quality & Feedback Loop

  • Identify and report false positives/negatives in the AI scanner to help improve model accuracy.
  • Contribute structured feedback to the ML/detection engineering team on edge cases and novel patterns.
  • Follow and help refine triage playbooks as the threat landscape evolves.

Shift Operations

  • Adhere to shift handover protocols — document open items, in-progress reviews, and any escalations for the incoming analyst.
  • Maintain situational awareness of the threat feed volume and velocity throughout your shift.
  • Participate in periodic sync calls with the Threat Research team to align on emerging threats and priority changes.

Required skills:

  • 2+ years of experience in a security operations, threat analysis, or malware analysis role.
  • Solid understanding of open source package ecosystems (npm, PyPI, RubyGems, etc.) and how supply chain attacks work.
  • Ability to read and understand code in at least one scripting language (JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Bash) — enough to spot obfuscation, exfiltration patterns, and suspicious behavior.
  • Strong written communication skills — you'll be writing triage notes that others rely on.
  • Comfort working independently during off-hours shifts with minimal supervision.
  • Reliability and punctuality — 24/7 coverage only works if shifts are honored.

ERM is the world s largest specialist sustainability consultancy, with over 50 years of experience helping organizations navigate complex environmental, social, and governance challenges. We bring together a global community of experts to deliver meaningful impact for our clients and the planet.

Our Consulting Delivery Hub (CDH) in India is a critical part of ERM s global consulting model enabling scalable, high-quality delivery across regions and service lines. CDH teams work in close partnership with regional consultants to support global client projects, providing specialist expertise, driving consistency, and enhancing delivery efficiency across our most important programmes.

As part of the Consulting Delivery Hub, you will collaborate with colleagues worldwide, contribute to complex sustainability projects, and play a key role in shaping the future of global consulting delivery.

Why this role matters

As a Consulting Senior Associate, Audit you will support ERM s global consulting delivery by supporting audit engagements under direction, completing assigned audit tasks, maintaining evidence records and applying ERM methodologies consistently. You will work within EHS Audit in the Consulting Delivery Hub, partnering with regional consultants, audit team leads, client process owners and internal delivery teams to deliver accurate evidence, working papers and audit documentation. This role is critical to consistent delivery quality, reliable audit evidence and efficient support to global client programmes.


What your impact is

  • Support delivery of ERM audit engagements that help clients shape a sustainable future.

  • Assist with audit planning, logistics, checklists, protocols and working papers accurately and on time.

  • Gather and record evidence, support sampling and testing, perform basic checks and flag exceptions early.

  • Help draft findings and maintain organized evidence records that clearly support conclusions.

  • Apply ERM and client health, safety, ethics and governance requirements, including independence expectations.

  • Build core audit capability through structured learning, fieldwork exposure and knowledge sharing.

What will you bring

  • Entry-level experience or strong interest in audit, environmental compliance, EHS, sustainability, engineering or related consulting domain.

  • Basic understanding of internal controls, audit concepts, evidence gathering and documentation discipline.

  • Strong Excel, documentation, attention to detail and willingness to learn structured audit methods.

  • Good communication skills and ability to work with global teams, regional consultants and client stakeholders.

  • Ability to complete assigned tasks to deadlines and escalate issues clearly when support is needed.

  • Willingness to travel for fieldwork where project requirements apply.

  • Bachelors degree in environmental, sustainability, health & safety science, engineering or a related discipline; early-career EHS experience in consulting or industry.

  • Awareness of ISO and relevant EHS management -system standards.

  • 1+ years of experience in Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS), environmental compliance, environmental auditing or related consulting services.

Preferred skills & competencies

  • Working towards internal-auditor, EHS auditor or management-system auditor training.

  • Exposure to EHS regulatory compliance audits or management-system assessments.

  • Familiarity with audit checklists, protocols, working-paper systems, data tracking or basic automation tools.

  • Interest in international and National standards and initiatives.

Key responsibilities

  • Support the Audit Team Lead in preparing audit documentation and planning logistics.

  • Complete assigned checklists, protocols and working papers accurately and within agreed timelines.

  • Gather, record and organize audit evidence against defined audit criteria.

  • Support sampling and testing activities, perform basic checks and flag exceptions or gaps.

  • Assist with drafting findings, observations and evidence summaries for team review.

  • Maintain audit logs, findings trackers and evidence record in a clear and auditable manner.

  • Support opening and closing meeting logistics, including notetaking where requested.

  • Follow ERM and client health, safety, ethics, confidentiality and governance requirements.

  • Deliver high standards of work to meet and exceed internal client expectations.

  • Build meaningful internal and external client relationships.

  • Maintain audit logs, findings trackers and working-paper records within audit systems.

  • Support EHS regulatory compliance audits and management-system assessments under direction, within ERMs Safe & Sustainable Operations practice; exposure to high-hazard sectors (mining, oil & gas, petrochemicals, pulp & paper, power generation).

  • Exposure to supporting environmental compliance audits or management system audits for clients in North America (NA) and/or EMEA (Europe, Middle East & Africa) is preferred.

  • Professional certifications such as ISO 14001:2015 Internal Auditor, ISO 45001:2018 Internal Auditor, ISO 9001:2015 Internal Auditor, or equivalent audit-related certifications are desirable.

Job Summary

As an ITGC Testing Analyst, you will support management in assessing the IT control environment. You will identify and report control weaknesses, track remediation action plans, and monitor the quality of remediation efforts.

Responsibilities

  • ITGC Testing: Conduct testing of IT General Controls (ITGCs) to ensure compliance and effectiveness.
  • ITC Testing: Perform testing of IT Components (ITCs) to validate data integrity and accuracy.
  • Test Scripts: Developing and executing test scripts, documenting test procedures, and evaluating results to identify control gaps.
  • Documentation: Maintain detailed documentation of testing procedures, findings, and recommendations.
  • Reporting: Ensure adherence to the approved assurance plan and provide regular updates on progress.
  • Issue Management: Advise IT operations on risk management and contribute to remediation plans for deficient controls.
  • Collaboration: Work with the offshore testing team to assess the design and effectiveness of IT controls.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Communicate effectively with stakeholders to ensure understanding and alignment with assurance processes and risk management strategies.
  • Tool Management: Oversee tools and reports used by the team and stakeholders, ensuring accuracy and updates based on business needs.

Requirements

We are a federal contractor or subcontractor required by law to provide equal employment opportunity to qualified people with disabilities. We are also required to measure our progress toward having at least 7% of our workforce be individuals with disabilities. To do this, we must ask applicants and employees if they have a disability or have ever had a disability. Because a person may become disabled at any time, we ask all of our employees to update their information at least every five years.

Identifying yourself as an individual with a disability is voluntary, and we hope that you will choose to do so. Your answer will be maintained confidentially and not be seen by selecting officials or anyone else involved in making personnel decisions. Completing the form will not negatively impact you in any way, regardless of whether you have self-identified in the past. For more information about this form or the equal employment obligations of federal contractors under Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act, visit the U.S. Department of Labor's Office of Federal Contract Compliance Programs (OFCCP) website at www.dol.gov/ofccp.","Description2":"How do you know if you have a disability?

  • Autism
  • Autoimmune disorder, for example, lupus, fibromyalgia, rheumatoid arthritis, or HIV/AIDS
  • Blind or low vision
  • Cancer
  • Cardiovascular or heart disease
  • Celiac disease
  • Cerebral palsy
  • Deaf or hard of hearing
  • Depression or anxiety
  • Diabetes
  • Epilepsy
  • Gastrointestinal disorders, for example, Crohn's Disease, or irritable bowel syndrome
  • Intellectual disability
  • Missing limbs or partially missing limbs
  • Nervous system condition for example, migraine headaches, Parkinson's disease, or Multiple sclerosis (MS)
  • Psychiatric condition, for example, bipolar disorder, schizophrenia, PTSD, or major depression

We are a federal contractor or subcontractor. The law requires us to provide equal employment opportunity to qualified people with disabilities. We have a goal of having at least 7% of our workers as people with disabilities. The law says we must measure our progress towards this goal. To do this, we must ask applicants and employees if they have a disability or have ever had one. People can become disabled, so we need to ask this question at least every five years.

Completing this form is voluntary, and we hope that you will choose to do so. Your answer is confidential. No one who makes hiring decisions will see it. Your decision to complete the form and your answer will not harm you in any way. If you want to learn more about the law or this form, visit the U.S. Department of Labor’s Office of Federal Contract Compliance Programs (OFCCP) website at www.dol.gov/ofccp.","Description2":"How do you know if you have a disability?


A disability is a condition that substantially limits one or more of your “major life activities.” If you have or have ever had such a condition, you are a person with a disability. Disabilities include, but are not limited to:


  • Alcohol or other substance use disorder (not currently using drugs illegally)
  • Autoimmune disorder, for example, lupus, fibromyalgia, rheumatoid arthritis, HIV/AIDS
  • Blind or low vision
  • Cancer (past or present)
  • Cardiovascular or heart disease
  • Celiac disease
  • Cerebral palsy
  • Deaf or serious difficulty hearing
  • Diabetes
  • Disfigurement, for example, disfigurement caused by burns, wounds, accidents, or congenital disorders
  • Epilepsy or other seizure disorder
  • Gastrointestinal disorders, for example, Crohn's Disease, irritable bowel syndrome
  • Intellectual or developmental disability
  • Mental health conditions, for example, depression, bipolar disorder, anxiety disorder, schizophrenia, PTSD
  • Missing limbs or partially missing limbs
  • Mobility impairment, benefiting from the use of a wheelchair, scooter, walker, leg brace(s) and/or other supports
  • Nervous system condition, for example, migraine headaches, Parkinson's disease, multiple sclerosis (MS)
  • Neurodivergence, for example, attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), autism spectrum disorder, dyslexia, dyspraxia, other learning disabilities
  • Partial or complete paralysis (any cause)
  • Pulmonary or respiratory conditions, for example, tuberculosis, asthma, emphysema
  • Short stature (dwarfism)
  • Traumatic brain injury
